description: The file defines the ViewFactory class responsible for managing view handlers within the OFBiz framework. It loads handlers based on configuration, provides a method to retrieve specific handlers by type, and sets up default behavior.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: Factory class for initializing and retrieving view handlers based on configuration and type.

methods.name: ViewFactory
methods.description: Constructor that loads view handlers from configuration URL and sets up a default handler if needed.

methods.name: getViewHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a view handler by type, defaulting to 'default' if no type is provided, or throws exception if not found.
